attempts.root_cause: The TMS worker preload library could not resolve libcudart.so.12.
attempts.remediation: Propagate the pinned venv CUDA runtime directory through every AReaL scheduling spec.

attempts.root_cause: Pinned SGLang read Qwen3_5Config.vocab_size, while the composite model exposes it under text_config.vocab_size.
attempts.remediation: Use the existing SGLang-only model overlay to expose seven text config dimensions without changing actor weights.

attempts.root_cause: The OPD config reserved only mem_fraction_static=0.45, below the existing Qwen3.5-4B SGLang recipe's 0.55 allocation.
attempts.remediation: Reuse the repository's proven Qwen3.5-4B SGLang mem_fraction_static=0.55 setting.

attempts.root_cause: The 8k Qwen3.5-4B cache setting mem_fraction_static=0.55 was still insufficient for the frozen 16k OPD context contract.
attempts.remediation: Use the repository's higher-context Qwen3.5 SGLang allocation mem_fraction_static=0.65 while retaining the 79 GiB guard.

attempts.root_cause: The colocated single-rank FSDP actor was already offloaded when AReaL broadcast locally available RPC metadata over its paused CUDA/NCCL communicator.
attempts.runtime_progress: M2 actor, frozen 9B teacher, SGLang overlay, M2 LoRA, CUDA graphs, and the 16k rollout server all initialized successfully before the RPC failure.
attempts.remediation: Skip redundant RPC payload broadcast only when the initialized context/model-parallel group has world size one; retain upstream behavior for every multi-rank engine.

attempts.failure_stage: AReaL initial offload policy after actor-rollout connection
attempts.root_cause: AReaL offloaded the colocated FSDP actor before SGLang initialization and then called FSDPEngine.offload a second time; torch_memory_saver aborted on the inactive allocation.
attempts.native_error: Cannot pause allocation that is not active
attempts.runtime_progress: The single-rank RPC bridge passed connect_engine; all model and rollout components initialized before the duplicate offload.
attempts.remediation: Make FSDPEngine.offload idempotent only inside the StudyHub OPD runtime, preserving the upstream transition whenever the engine is resident.

attempts.failure_stage: AReaL AgentWorkflow proxy initialization after initial rollout offload
attempts.root_cause: Pinned AReaL applied the colocated rollout offload policy before lazily starting Hermes proxy workers; proxy initialization then health-checked an intentionally offloaded SGLang server and timed out.
attempts.native_error: Inference server failed to become healthy within 300 seconds after release_memory_occupation
attempts.runtime_progress: Actor, frozen teacher, SGLang, M2 LoRA, connect_engine, and the idempotent actor offload bridge all passed before proxy startup waited on the offloaded server.
attempts.remediation: For the first proxy start only, temporarily onload the colocated rollout for proxy health binding and restore the original offloaded state before the upstream train loop begins.

attempts.failure_stage: First Hermes workflow construction after successful proxy initialization
attempts.root_cause: The selected OPD pool contained complete per-task verifier JSON files but no split-level verifier JSONL consumed by StudyHubHermesWorkflow.
attempts.native_error: no verifier JSONL files under the processed OPD prompt pool verifier root
attempts.runtime_progress: Both train and eval proxies bound to the temporarily live SGLang server, the rollout returned to its upstream offloaded state, and the first workflow submission began.
attempts.remediation: Package selected verifiers into hashed train/validation JSONL files and fail preflight unless every task maps to an identity-matched verifier and environment.

attempts.failure_stage: First OPD student anchor forward after successful Hermes rollout
attempts.root_cause: The StudyHub sparse-output bridge supplied one padded width per trajectory to AReaL, while AReaL reordered one output sequence per API interaction inside each trajectory. The generic split helper would also have trimmed the final top-k axis instead of the sequence axis for rank-3 sparse tensors.
attempts.native_error: IndexError: list index out of range in reorder_and_pad_outputs while indexing output_seqlens with interaction-level forward_indices
attempts.runtime_progress: Four real Hermes trajectories completed and produced four Reward v3 records before the first student anchor forward; two were strict successes and all four were eligible for policy update.
attempts.remediation: Flatten unpadded attention-mask lengths per API interaction for AReaL reordering, then split by trajectory interaction counts and trim the sequence axis explicitly.

attempts.failure_stage: First OPD student anchor forward after packed-output repair
attempts.root_cause: The colocated 4B actor used a 16,384-token microbatch limit. A 12,866-token anchor microbatch began with 69.91 GiB already resident after SGLang offload and exhausted CUDA virtual-memory allocation during forward.
attempts.native_error: torch_memory_saver.cpp CUresult error: 2 (out of memory) in cu_mem_create
attempts.runtime_progress: The packed interaction-length repair passed, four additional real Hermes trajectories and Reward v3 rows completed, and AReaL reached the first anchor forward before CUDA OOM.
attempts.remediation: Use 4,096 actor and 8,192 teacher max tokens per microbatch, retaining the same global batch, data, OPD objective, and learning rate. Isolate Reward v3 output by attempt so failed runs cannot contaminate a passing stage marker.

attempts.failure_stage: First frozen 9B teacher selected-token score after a successful 4B student anchor
attempts.root_cause: Pinned AReaL microbatch-splits token tensors only when their element count equals batch times sequence. The OPD [batch, sequence, top_k] student anchor was consequently copied as a whole-batch constant into each teacher microbatch instead of following AReaL's forward indices and packing order.
attempts.native_error: ValueError: logits and token_ids must have shapes [tokens, vocab] and [tokens, k]
attempts.runtime_progress: Four real Hermes trajectories and attempt-isolated Reward v3 rows completed. The 4B actor anchor passed with 4,096-token microbatches and was restored to every trajectory; the frozen 9B teacher then began its first two microbatches before the sparse payload shape failure. Peak actor-anchor memory remained below the 79 GiB guard and no OOM occurred.
attempts.remediation: Encode each of the 16 top-k wings as a standard [batch, sequence] token field before the pinned AReaL splitter, then reassemble [tokens, k] inside the teacher and actor callbacks. This reuses upstream forward indices, packing, and padding without changing AReaL source or OPD math.

claim_boundary: Attempts 20260901_214833, 20260901_220024, and 20260901_220910 each produced four real Hermes trajectories and four Reward v3 rows. Attempt 20260901_220910 additionally completed the 4B student anchor. No recorded attempt produced an optimizer update, passing LR marker, or OPD model result.
